text:
elaine: quick sync — sylph8b-int6 bring-up summary? want a compact econ+quality snapshot for GTN by EOD :hourglass: 

matt: short version: int6 looks promising on cost but has a longform recall bump in some slices. numbers below.

raj: perf notes: p50 ~110ms, p95 ~185ms on our A100 pool, KV cache hit ~34% right now (we didn't warm prefixes). throughput ~11 rps/gpu at avg seq=256.

lucy: quality: regression vs baseline (float) on multi-paragraph summarization. ROUGE-L down ~3.1, factuality checks show more entity drops on API-style prompts. short answers are fine.

matt: econ snippet (rough):
```
cost_per_token: $0.0009
tokens_per_req (avg): 180
reqs_per_min_per_gpu: 660
unit_cost_per_request: ~$0.16
```

elaine: can someone distill into a 1-line recommendation for product/GTN? product wants either green (rollout) / amber (limited) / red (hold).

lucy: amber — OK to route low-latency short-turn chat + embeddings but hold for long-form summarization until we fix hallucination slice.

raj: agree. ops note: add prefix warmstart and bump KV cache TTL for the next canary to measure improvement.

matt: suggestion for GTN blurb: "Sylph8b-int6 reduces token spend ~20% vs 8-bit baseline with comparable short-form quality; regressions observed on multi-paragraph summarization — recommend gated rollout for chat/QA and further evals for longform use cases."

elaine: perfect. ops-bot, schedule a canary with 5% traffic to chat routes and 0% to longform summarizers. include A/B where we warm KV cache.

ops-bot: scheduled canary: sylph8b-int6 -> 2026-03-24T18:00Z, 5% chat routes, geo: us-west, warm-kv: true :white_check_mark:

lucy: I'll prepare a short eval deck with slice examples and a fix plan (top 3 hypotheses + priming experiments).

matt: I'll run a quick cost/latency sweep with warmed cache and post updated numbers tomorrow morning.

elaine: thanks — that's actionable. we'll brief GTN with matt/lucy tomorrow. :thumbsup:
